result.title: Proactive Physical AI through Continuous Observation and Timely Intervention
result.summary: Physical AI is commonly formulated around an explicitly specified task: given a goal or instruction, a system perceives, reasons, and acts. In many real-world settings, however, important tasks emerge from continuously changing world states before a person explicitly formulates them. We study this complementary problem as Proactive Physical AI, where an AI system continuously observes the physical world, identifies situations that warrant intervention, and initiates appropriate actions at the right time. We develop ProAgent, an end-to-end system built around two components: a Jev-style proactive timing model (dubbed StreamingJev) that determines whether and when intervention is needed, and a Response Model that generates responses for people or invokes available device capabilities for physical execution. To support learning at scale, we develop an automated data pipeline that converts videos into supervision for proactive timing. Experiments demonstrate strong proactive performance under both explicit objectives and standing roles, combining more accurate intervention timing with fewer false triggers than the source-backbone baseline. Real-robot evaluations further demonstrate ProAgent's ability to identify emerging needs and translate them into appropriate physical actions.

AI.brief_summary: 论文提出「Proactive Physical AI」设定：系统持续观察不断变化的物理世界，自主判断是否需要以及何时介入，并构建端到端系统 ProAgent（Jev 式流式时机模型 StreamingJev 加响应模型），配套把视频自动转成介入时机监督的数据管线，在真实机器人上验证介入时机与误触发表现。
AI.relevance_reason: 其流式「是否/何时介入」的时机判定与视频自动构造监督，可能与 LVR 的 STOP 决策和过程监督同构，可供核查该 timing 模型能否迁移为 latent 推理的停止判据；但属机器人主动感知场景，与多模态推理主线距离较远。
